item.title: Speed Management
item.description:
Traffic calming and speed management initiatives.

Neighborhood Traffic Management Program#

  • Neighborhood Traffic Management Program

    Provides the maintained program overview for addressing speeding and cut-through traffic on residential streets, including eligibility, request procedures, current meetings, completed studies, policy documents, and emergency-route constraints.

  • Submit a Traffic Calming Request

    Explains how residents request a City traffic-calming evaluation, what information the application requires, which streets qualify, and where to submit the online or written request.

item.title: Studies
item.description:
Transportation studies and reports.

City Corridor and Neighborhood Studies#

Central Avenue: 1st Street to Girard#

  • Official City Project Page

    Collects the City’s project history and current authoritative links for the Central Avenue Complete Street Plan and Design Toolkit between Downtown and Girard Boulevard.

  • March 2014 Draft Plan and Design Toolkit (archived PDF)

    Documents existing conditions, public priorities, multimodal design concepts, catalytic redevelopment areas, implementation strategies, and block-by-block recommendations for Central Avenue between First Street and Girard Boulevard.
